notes.title: Update İn Progress
notes.content:
Stay tuned for our comprehensive update on june 7th.
what we've accomplished so far: 

Change:
*Skill UIs now remain as you left them.
*Potato value has been transferred to the order upgrade tab.
*Cooldowns for fireball, double portal, hussar, and tamer abilities have been removed; instead, they now accumulate every wave like guards.
*In the blacksmith, iron work name has been changed to mouse attack.
*Mouse attack hitbox increased, now you can deal damage with the center of the sword.
*After their use, skills automatically disappear from the cursor, unless they have remaining charges.
*The arrival time of monsters at the beginning of waves has been brought forward, so now you can start action without waiting.

Fix:
*Fixed ghoul charm knockback.
*Fixed an issue where monsters touching the double portal would cause the game to crash.
*Fixed the initial size issue of the teleportation portal.
*Fixed the duration of the portal and double portal.
